title: Fruit By Supergood Guava Dragonfruit & Blueberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Guava, Dragonfruit and Blueberry is an exotic and sophisticated fruit fusion. It layers the smooth, mellow taste of tropical Guava with the light, crisp notes of Dragonfruit, finishing with a burst of juicy Blueberry sweetness. This unique combination offers a soft yet flavourful tropical experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 10ml 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This allows you to customise your nicotine strength while enjoying the incredible value of a larger bottle. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable.
